short_blurb: Remodels, additions & ADUs — licensed general contractor in Palos Verdes Estates.
local_note: Palos Verdes Estates homeowners choose Palm Crest Builders for kitchen and bath remodels, room additions, ADUs, and whole-home renovations. We know the local building department, design for Palos Verdes Estates's mix of housing styles, and manage design, permits, and construction with our own licensed crews. We build throughout Palos Verdes Estates, including Malaga Cove, Lunada Bay, Valmonte, and nearby neighborhoods. Every project is built to the California Building Code and backed by our workmanship warranty.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Palos Verdes Estates?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Palos Verdes Estates building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Palos Verdes Estates?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Palos Verdes Estates rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Palos Verdes Estates remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
